reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR covers new complete electromechanical endless-band-knife splitting machines for dry leather in shoe and leather-goods manufacture. Declare working width, knife and feed/presser configuration, delivered grinding and suction equipment, drive, controls and guards. Exclude wet tanning drums, large whole-hide wet tannery splitters, fleshing/shaving, bell-knife edge skiving, sewing, other shoemaking machines and separately traded spare parts. CPC 44630 is broader than this methodology boundary. Include actual factory trials, samples, adjustment, rework and attributable utilities and wastes. Exclude tannery/customer leather production, routine leather throughput, customer use/maintenance, lifetime and disposal. No leather-processing service is provided by this manufacturing reference.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete configured dry-leather band-knife splitting machines
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Wet tannery splitting/tanning, fleshing/shaving, edge skiving, sewing, other footwear lines and spare parts
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New complete accepted machine at factory gate, without trial leather or dust; packaging separately inventoried

authored_review_metadata.semantic_boundary_decision: New complete electromechanical endless-band-knife machine for dry-leather splitting in leather-goods or shoe manufacture. Narrower than CPC44630; exclude wet tanning drums, whole-hide wet tannery splitters, shaving/fleshing, bell-knife skiving, sewing, other shoemaking machinery and spare parts. No complete material leather-machine overlap found in local index; existing weaving/knitting machinery has distinct product and test-media boundaries. Old scaffold and shared maps unchanged. Actual delivered knife/feed/presser/grinding/suction/drive/control/guards and retained lubricant define M; factory sample trials included, customer leather processing excluded.
